You sensed a vast presence and stopped in your tracks.{w}{p}In an instant the presence blanketed the world, bearing down on you with overwhelming might.{w}{p}This is the shadow of one who dwells "outside" the world.{w}A being unlike you.{w}{p}Beware!
You must never encounter it!{w}{p}This is a warning.{w}

Suffocated

Then your bodies were wrapped in a dazzling light and carried off somewhere.{w}
Searching the area, you found something.{w}
You found the Jewel Ring!{w}
Take it?

en: Wrapped in a cold wind, a warrior whose very presence foretold death appeared before you.{w}

"You got to the divine relic before us...
you're not bad at all."{w}{p}"Hmm...
Is it thanks to that shiny, glowing item of yours?"{w}{p}"Too bad for you, after you went to the trouble of finding it, but{w}you're handing that divine relic over to us."{w}{p}"I won't take no for an answer.
I'll take it by force if I have to!"{w}
note: Nonhared: gruff. kochira = 'us' (ore-tachi earlier in the line). | Accuracy: restored subject (you got there first; nakanaka yaru = you are pretty good).

en: Nonhared

note: indou wo watasu = deliver the last rites / finish off.

en: The warrior departed along with the chill.{w}
note: No pronoun for Nonhared (gender unknown).

en:
"GOGAAAAAAHHH!!
They said it was around here, but I can't find it!"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Donnelkral (name box 1052).

en: A dragon you had never seen before appeared in front of you.{w}

"And I'm starviiing!{w}Dammit, where's that divine relic...{w}Relic... relic... meat... relic... meat... meat..."{w}{p}"Hm?"{w}{p}"That thing you've got there...
Could it be... MEEEAT?!{w}No wait, the divine relIIIC?!"{w}{p}"Oh craaap! Somebody beat me to iiit!{w}The mighty me got told to go find it!
And yet the divine relic is already in that punk's haaands?!"{w}{p}"Whoa, I'm gonna get chewed out for this!
What do I do... what do I do..."{w}{p}"Grooooohhh..."{w}{p}"Oooooooohhh......"{w}{p}"Oooooooooohhhh.........{w}Hn?"{w}{p}"If I just eat you lot,
I get the divine relic AND a full belly...
it's nothing but upside?!"{w}{p}"Whoa whoa whoa!{w}Ain't I amazing?! Ain't I a genius?!{w}My own brilliance scares meeee!!"{w}{p}"So that's the deal, you morons!!
Get eaten, get robbed, and then...{w}DIEEEEEEE!!"{w}
note: Short 'relic' in the chanted fragments (shingu...niku...); full 'divine relic' elsewhere. ore-sama -> 'the mighty me'. aitsu (that one) -> 'that punk' to stay gender-neutral.

en: Donnelkral

note: houkoku shite yaru -> 'tell on you' (childish tantrum register).

en: The dragon flew off in a furious rage.{w}

"I seeee...
So that's how you've been finding the divine relics."{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Escapra (name box 1060).

en:
You turned around to find a monstrous woman standing there.
Demonic in form, she ran her eyes over you as if licking you all over.{w}
note: Licking gaze kept as the licking image; 'she' per narration (igyou no onna) and glossary.

en:
"With something pointing right at the spot like that,
no wonder we couldn't get ahead of you,
what with us going on Urna's hunches."{w}{p}"Well, you found it, so I'll call that good enough.{w}If I manage to bring it back,
our boss's share oughta go up too."{w}{p}"Now then, you get to choose.{w}Die torn apart by my claws,
or die skewered on these sharp tentacles?"{w}{p}"...Eh? You want to try both?{w}My, aren't you a greedy one!!"{w}
note: uchi no taishou -> 'our boss' (presumably Zeshrom, not named).

en: Escapra

"GYIIIAAAAAAGH?!{w}...Tch! What the hell is this?!{w}My attack got blocked?!"{w}{p}"No wonder those two had such a hard time...{w}Kukuku... Oh, I like it, I like it!{w}This is getting more and more fun!!"{w}{p}"You lot, go get stronger...{w}Next time I'll kill you with everything I've got...
Kukuku!!"{w}
note: 'those two' = Nonhared and Donnelkral.

en:
The monstrous woman swayed her body gleefully,
then bounded away with a terrifying leap.{w}

"Halt!{w}That divine relic belongs in my hand!
Do not lay your lowly fingers upon it!!"{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Urna (imperious ware register: formal English).

en:
As you reached for the divine relic,
a voice charged with anger rang out.{w}A woman was glaring at you with eyes full of rage.{w}
"So you too would betray me,{w}and seek to bar my return!"{w}{p}"Though I raised you,{w}taught you how to live, taught you song, taught you love,{w}and saved you from ruin...!"{w}
"Have you forgotten my heart?!{w}Have you forgotten your promise to me?!{w}Worse still, have you forgotten even my name?!!"{w}
No, you DO know her name!{w}You called out her name.{w}
"Even ingratitude has its lim--?!{w}Hm? Huh???{w}S-say that... one more time?"{w}
note: Interrupted mid-sentence ; register drops to casual (itte mi).

en: You called her name once more.{w}
Urna
"Y-you know it...?{w}My name...?!{w}How? Nobody knew it..."{w}{p}"Reiblair... was it?{w}I see, so that device is still working!"{w}{p}"Um... so, then...{w}well... uh...{w}I mean... um... um..."{w}
note: Reiblair (glossary: place) taken as where the party learned her name; 'that device' kept vague as in source.

en: "I... I'm h-home?"
note: Choice prompt line (Urna's 'tadaima'); the choices answer it.

en: Welcome back!
Say nothing
"......"{w}{p}"Why... won't you say anything...?{w}We promised, didn't we... that we'd be together again...{w}This joke... is too cruel..."{w}{p}"Hey..."{w}{p}"......"{w}{p}"......Ngh!!"{w}
note: 'Say nothing' branch; the promise line trails off; English completes 'together again' minimally.

en: "Ahh...{w}Uuu... hic... sniff...{w}I-I'm back... I came back, you know?"{w}{p}"With everyone... again...{w}I wanted to live... happily...{w}to see everyone's smiles... a-again... hic..."{w}{p}"But no matter where I looked,{w}nobody came to welcome me...{w}Everyone... they... me... Waaaaaah!!"{w}
note: 'Welcome back' branch. 'minna, watashi wo...' is an unfinished sentence (object with no verb), kept broken. | Accuracy: 'had' read as a verb the source lacks ('had me' = fooled/caught); minna, watashi wo... now stays an object-only broken fragment. | Editorial: middle page reordered so each sob-broken piece lands on the same {w} pause as the source (with everyone, again / live happily / smiles again); wording unchanged.

en: Urna threw her arms around you.
note: Source has no {w}; none added.

en: "I found... kids who know me...{w}I'm so happy... so happyyy..."{w}{p}"I'm h-home...{w}Sorry I kept you waiting... really, I'm so sorry...{w}Let's be close again, okay? Okay?"{w}
note: ko -> 'kids' (Urna's motherly view of the people of the land; cf. kono ko-tachi in 1090).

en: "A touching reunion, I take it."{w}
note: Speaker ??? = Zeshrom (name box 1091; courteous register).

"Zeshrom!{w}Look! These kids,
they remembered me!"{w}
